source_caption_text:
50 Cent had his own video game in 2005, and Eminem played a corrupt detective in it 😭🎮

“50 Cent: Bulletproof” featured Em as Detective McVicar, a crooked cop who supplies 50 with information for a price 😂 His scenes gave fans a chance to hear him step into a completely different character, bringing plenty of personality and humor to the role.

The cast also included Lloyd Banks, Tony Yayo, and Young Buck alongside 50, while Dr. Dre played a character named Grizz. They really brought the crew into a video game 🔥

Looking back, it’s a time capsule of an era when 50’s world extended far beyond the music. Getting to play as him while running into familiar voices made the whole experience even more memorable 💯

Who remembers playing “Bulletproof” back in the day? 👀
